name: Steal An Egg
summary: No Steal An Egg codes are listed in the game's official description or by any source we can verify. Here's what we know, and where new codes would appear.
about:
Steal An Egg is a Roblox collection game where you steal eggs, bring them back to your base, hatch them into pets, and earn money from the pets you keep. Other players can steal from you, and you can steal from them.

It's one of the biggest games on Roblox, with over a million players online at once in September 2026, which is why so many people search for codes.
codesNote:
We haven't found any Steal An Egg codes. None are listed in the game's official Roblox description, and we haven't seen one from a source we can verify.

We also haven't confirmed in-game whether Steal An Egg has a code redeem box at all. If it doesn't, there's nowhere to enter a code even if one existed. We'll update this page once we've checked.

Until a code shows up in the game's official channels, be careful with videos or sites listing "working Steal An Egg codes" without saying where they came from.

faq.q: Does Steal An Egg have codes?
faq.a: Not that we can find. No codes are listed in the game's official Roblox description or by any source we can verify. We haven't yet confirmed in-game whether the game has a redeem box.

faq.q: How can I tell if a Roblox game has codes at all?
faq.a: Look for a redeem box, usually in the shop or settings menu. If a game has no box, it has no codes.

faq.q: Where would the first codes appear?
faq.a: Developers usually announce codes in the game's Roblox description, its Roblox group, or its Discord first.

faq.q: Will Steal An Egg ever get codes?
faq.a: Nobody can say for certain. Our tracker watches the game's Roblox description and flags any change that looks like a code, and this page is updated once a person checks it.

faq.q: How often do you check this?
faq.a: The game's Roblox page is watched automatically, and the date at the top of this page changes only when a person reviews it.
